claims.claim_text: For a high temperature alarm that clears and comes back with the cabinet door closed, change the filter before anything else, since a clogged filter is the usual reason. If it still comes back with a clean filter, check that the fans actually ramp up when the alarm is on, and don't touch the temperature thresholds.
claims.symptom: high temperature alarm that clears on its own and comes back
claims.check_step: check that the cabinet door is closed and when the filter was changed
